title: RehydrationReport.v1
description: The result of rehydrate(store, artifact_id, tenant): the proof that a derived artifact can be walked back to its raw + source layer, with the held-out items, rejected candidates, and receipts recovered alongside. A rehydration is only 'rehydrated:true' when it reaches at least one source artifact id (check enforces source_artifact_ids non-empty when rehydrated). Never crosses a tenant boundary — a rehydration for tenant A can only return tenant A (and global_public) artifacts; crossed_tenant_boundary MUST be false.

rehydrated.description: true only when the source layer was reached

source_artifact_ids.description: reachable source artifact ids; MUST be non-empty when rehydrated is true

held_out_artifact_ids.description: held-out items recovered (e.g. FAQ-30, allegations) — present, not erased

crossed_tenant_boundary.description: MUST be false; a true value is a tenant-leak and is rejected

failure_reason.description: set when rehydrated is false (e.g. source_unreachable, tenant_mismatch)
